% An article with natbib whose \bibsep of 0pt is set in a group around the
% bibliography, so that the entries are close together in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage[numbers]{natbib}
\begin{document}
Some text, as cited in \cite{book} and \cite{paper}.
{\setlength{\bibsep}{0pt}
\begin{thebibliography}{9}
\bibitem{book} A.~Author. \emph{A Book}. 2000.
\bibitem{paper} B.~Writer. A paper. 2001.
\end{thebibliography}}
\end{document}
